door3._note_rn_keep_rank: WO_DS3 item 2 (2026-11-13). A Door-3 name that was research_now on the previous published list keeps its slot while it ranks within 8 of Door 3's names by universe momentum; free slots fill from the top; always 5 names. Measured by replay on the 87 stored runs of 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-12 (28 trading days): with no keep band the five changed 90 times at day level and 50 of 74 changes reversed within 5 trading days; with 8, 68 changes and 31 of 54 reversed; with 10, 64 and 31 of 50 (no fewer reversals). The 5th and 8th names differ by a median of 0.064 of universe momentum z (the 1st and 5th by 0.308). The rest of the churn is names leaving Door 3 altogether (trend break, or nominated by Door 1/2), which no band on the split can hold.
door3._note_profitability_min_pctl: C10 (PHASE_3_APPROVAL.md, orchestrator measurement 2026-09-24) — renamed from DOOR3_QUALITY_MIN_PCTL. The quality pillar's accruals and gross-margin-stability terms penalise hypergrowth working capital, so the old quality floor excluded NVDA (quality z -1.34), SNDK (12-1 return +1,296%), WDC and COHR while admitting unprofitable biotechs. Replaced with a profitability-only floor: sector-neutral roic_proxy z >= this percentile of the scored universe's roic_proxy z distribution (missing roic_proxy -> not eligible, reason no_profitability_data). Applies to Door 3 only; Door 1/2's quality pillar is unchanged.
door3._note_jump_share: P3.14b (orchestrator measurement 2026-09-24) — Door 3's first run picked PACS (one month = 90% of its 12-1 log gain, +177%) and IBRX (98%, +216%, only 5/11 months up): event jumps, not trends. jump_share = ln(1+largest single-month return)/ln(1+12-1 return); above this is not Door-3-eligible (reason jump_driven). Momentum research (Da, Gurun & Warachka 2014, 'frog in the pan') finds continuous gains persist and discrete jumps do not.
door3._note_jump_rule_min_return: R1 (orchestrator refinement 2026-09-24) — the jump rule applies only when 12-1 >= 0.50 (a small total gain makes any single month look dominant — NVDA at +18% was excluded with jump_share 0.795).
